title: NIAGADS: A Comprehensive National Data Repository for Alzheimer’s Disease and Related Dementia Genetics and Genomics Research
authors: Kuzma A; Valladares O; Greenfest-Allen E; Nicaretta H; Kirsch M; Ren Y; Katanic Z; White H; Wilk A; Bass L; Brettschneider J; Carter L; Cifello J; Chuang W; Clark K; Gangadharan P; Haut J; Ho P; Horng W; Iqbal T; Jin Y; Keskinen P; Rose AL; Moon MK; Manuel J; Qu L; Robbins F; Saravanan N; Sha J; Tate S; Zhao Y; Cantwell L; Gardner J; Chou S; Tzeng J; Bush W; Naj A; Kuksa P; Lee W; Leung YY; Schellenberg G; Wang L
one_liner_zh: 该文介绍阿尔茨海默病遗传学数据存储库NIAGADS，属于数据资源平台，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: NIAGADS is the National Institute on Aging (NIA) designated national data repository for human genetics research on Alzheimer’s Disease and related dementia (ADRD). NIAGADS maintains a high-quality data collection for ADRD genetic/genomic research and supports genetics data production and analysis. NIAGADS hosts whole genome and exome sequence data from the Alzheimer’s Disease Sequencing Project (ADSP) and other genotype/phenotype data, encompassing 209,000 samples. NIAGADS shares these data with hundreds of research groups around the world via the Data Sharing Service, a FISMA moderate compliant cloud- based platform that fully supports the NIH Genome Data Sharing Policy. NIAGADS Open Access consists of multiple knowledge bases with genome-wide association summary statistics and rich annotations on the biological significance of genetic variants and genes across the human genome. NIAGADS stands as a keystone in promoting collaborations to advance the understanding and treatment of Alzheimer’s disease.
abstract_zh: NIAGADS是国家老龄化研究所（NIA）指定的国家人类遗传学研究数据存储库，专注于阿尔茨海默病及相关痴呆症（ADRD）的研究。NIAGADS维护着高质量的ADRD遗传/基因组研究数据集合，并支持遗传数据的生成与分析。NIAGADS托管来自阿尔茨海默病测序项目（ADSP）的全基因组和外显子组序列数据，以及其他基因型/表型数据，涵盖209,000个样本。NIAGADS通过数据共享服务（Data Sharing Service）与全球数百个研究小组共享这些数据，该服务是一个符合FISMA中等合规要求的云平台，完全支持NIH基因组数据共享政策。NIAGADS开放访问包含多个知识库，提供全基因组关联汇总统计以及人类基因组中遗传变异和基因生物学意义的丰富注释。NIAGADS在促进合作以推进阿尔茨海默病的理解与治疗方面发挥着基石作用。
